How do episodes appear on amazon prime and what are all the major streaming platforms they appear on with the vip?

ISTV episodes airing on Amazon Prime are pay-to-view only: viewers can have a regular Amazon account, but an ISTV episode requires a small one-time fee, not a monthly subscription. Main ISTV VIP/Premium includes submission to one Tier-1 streaming platform: Amazon Prime Video, the Apple TV streaming app, or Tubi.
